plan.understanding: Replace the large gear's rounded outer tooth profile with straight-cut spur gear teeth while retaining its existing tooth count, pitch, clocking, and overall size.

subtasks.goal: Edit only s1. Reconfirm the target as the outer 27-fold perimeter whose Y-parallel boundary surfaces comprise the complete s1 families r=1.9844 mm at Y≈-1.588 mm and r=3.9942 mm at Y≈-1.587 mm; identify each member by adjacency to the outer loop of the planar rim faces at Y=0 and Y=-3.175 mm, excluding s0 and s1's inner features. Use the center and [0,1,0] axis of the full r=15.8256 mm s1 cylindrical face. Read the reference tooth directly from either indexed rim boundary loop, without a section operation: locate its local radial maximum, its two neighboring root minima, and the angular endpoints where the rounded tooth surfaces join adjacent perimeter faces. Construct a straight-sided trapezoidal tooth by placing one straight tip line tangent to the old perimeter at that local maximum, intersecting it with rays through the two measured tooth-transition angles, and joining those tip endpoints to the two measured root minima with straight flanks. Connect successive root minima with straight root chords. This tangent-tip construction retains the old tooth's outward support at its center instead of forcing the tip to be an inward chord. Rotate the reference geometry 27 times around the measured Y axis at the measured 13.333333-degree pitch to form one closed 27-tooth XZ perimeter. Determine from radial containment tests on the existing Y=0 and Y=-3.175 loops the outermost continuous core radius lying wholly inboard of every root chord. Within only Y=-3.175 to Y=0, retain s1 inside that measured core radius, remove all existing s1 material outside it, and union the annular portion of the new polygonal profile extruded parallel to [0,1,0] across the same measured interval. Preserve all portions of s1 outside that interval and leave s0 untouched. Confirm that the edited rim has 27 repeated straight tip faces and 54 straight flank faces parallel to the measured Y axis, and that none of the original r=1.9844 or r=3.9942 rounded perimeter faces remains in that interval.
